page.overview:
Who is D. Ewing?

D. Ewing is an employee at Jurassic World (rank unknown) who is seen in an email sending out a request to everyone in the lab to return a lost plushy if they find it. The plushy in question is an Ankylosaurus that can be found behind some crates.
